protocol.status: Frozen before any Club decay slope fit, model tail measurements or FDN control renders.
protocol.chronology: Targeted follow-up to known Club/Ambient envelope counterexamples; source-only feasibility/support already saved. This does not replace or select from earlier outcomes.
protocol.estimator: Complete symmetric-Hann rFFT windows entirely within each support; correctly doubled one-sided squared spectrum divided by N*sum(w^2), integrated in fixed bands. Whole-channel broadband RMS uses unweighted samples. Fit ordinary linear dB-versus-window-center on training only; predict all later-window levels. Fit model separately on exact same support as descriptive comparison. Overlapping windows are not independent samples; no statistical confidence claims.
protocol.guards: All80-640 bands remain predeclared. Retain all rows/failures. Flag training/evaluation band levels below-120dBFS or <0.1% of Hann-weighted full power; original quiet-reference coverage remains from source-only audit. No candidate-dependent bins or retuning.

gain_and_alignment.alignment_method: 10 ms RMS-envelope normalized correlation; integer sample grid
gain_and_alignment.gain_method: one scalar RMS gain over calibration interval after alignment

protocol.transform: Use only existing baseline232sample lag and gain1.8256797473972683; hardware source index t maps to candidate index t+232. No new fit, time warp, controller or MIDI changes.

fdn_controls.input: Fixed-seed xorshift white/dark noise and fixed-phase D2(73.416Hz) harmonic/sine; Hann burst viaExtIn. Exact original Club reverb block, delayoff, filterbypass. No oscillator/damping candidates.
fdn_controls.timing: Source final gate2.21s maps to burst end.20s; all control audio indices add fixed93sample architecture latency. This is operational gate-age matching, not measured original key-up.
fdn_controls.purpose: Compare3window estimators and4known excitation spectra through actual shipping FDN; compare early short-support estimates with settled longer-support estimates to expose modal/time-dependent bias. Neither is assumed exact hardware T60.

protocol.shelf_diagnostic: Measure actual current first-order HF shelf impulse response at80,sqrt(80*160),160,sqrt(160*320),320,sqrt(320*640),640Hz,4kHz andNyquist; LFneutral. This is per-pass engine attenuation only, not hardware decay or evidence of internal placement.
controls: Planted exponential amplitude with-20dB/s power-level slope, sinusoidal and dense-harmonic inputs; verify short-window estimator variability.
Posthoc uniform0.5 scaling must leave every slope unchanged and shift levels-6.0206dB; do not select return gain.
claims_excluded: No isolated HFgain calibration: allprimarybands farbelow4k.
No inferred exactMIDI release or hardwareFDN.

paired_level_differences.definition: Arithmetic mean of aligned per-window shipping minus hardware dB levels, separately on the frozen training/check supports. No fitted scalar. Difference-of-means is invariant to an added constant level offset.

conclusion.status: A simple output scalar cannot remove the current conditional tail mismatch; no unique decay/damping law identified.
conclusion.constant_gain_invariant_evidence: Allthreewindow specifications preserve extra shipping broadband attenuation between train and check (2.31-2.42dB stereo,4.41-4.58dB side).
conclusion.slope_limitation: Some trained band slopes predict later levels poorly and move substantially with window length. Actual fixed shipping-FDN bursts reproduce such early modal/excitation instability, including positive apparent slopes.
conclusion.damping_scope: Eligible bands80-640Hz lie farbelow4k. Actual shippingHF shelf single-pass attenuation is only0.00164-0.10407dB there. This does not identify hardware shelving or exclude accumulated per-loop influence.
conclusion.weak_controls: Every settled control band fit has at least one sample below frozen-120dBFS level guard. D2sine non-fundamental bands additionally fail relative-power guards. These are retained diagnostics, not accepted stationary decay estimates.

independent_code_review.scope: Consequential estimator, source and latency checks; no edits.
independent_code_review.result: No consequential bug found. Hann normalization, odd/even one-sided weighting, stereo mean-power, separated supports, frozen232sample lag/gain and single93sample control offset checked.
independent_code_review.qualification: EXT-IN includes the current3.4Hz input high-pass filter and initial monitor/input slews. These are full-current-engine burst controls, not a bare FDN impulse. Their instability is evidence of combined modal/excitation/processing bias, not proof of its unique cause.
